# InfoHQ
> InfoHQ is an AI and software engineering studio helping startups and enterprises across India build, automate, and grow — operating a hybrid model of B2B client engineering and proprietary AI SaaS products.

## Services
- [AI & Intelligent Systems](https://infohq.in/services/ai-intelligent-systems): Practical AI agents, RAG systems, and custom-built business software.
- [Custom Software Development](https://infohq.in/services/custom-software): Purpose-built business software, end-to-end multi-tenant SaaS platforms, robust REST/GraphQL APIs, and internal portals.
- [Modern Web Development](https://infohq.in/services/web-development): High-converting business websites, interactive client portals & dashboards, headless CMS platforms, sub-second page performance, and full SEO optimization.
- [Mobile App Development (iOS & Android)](https://infohq.in/services/mobile-app-development): Cross-platform and native mobile apps with offline-first local database caching, background sync, biometric security, and app store deployment.
- [Business Automation](https://infohq.in/services/business-automation): Custom workflow automation, bi-directional tool/app synchronization (CRMs, payments, email, accounting), and automated document pipelines.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://infohq.in/services/cloud-devops): Cloud architecture (AWS, GCP, Cloudflare), zero-downtime automated CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, Docker containerization, and proactive health/uptime monitoring.
- [Cybersecurity](https://infohq.in/services/cybersecurity): OWASP Top 10 application security audits, secure authentication systems (JWT, MFA, RBAC), server and firewall hardening, and TLS encryption.
- [Website Maintenance & Support](https://infohq.in/services/website-maintenance): Routine security and plugin updates, automated daily backups with 1-click restore, ongoing Core Web Vitals speed optimization, and fast bug fixes.
- [UI/UX Design](https://infohq.in/services/ui-ux-design): User journey mapping, wireframing, high-fidelity responsive UI design, interactive Figma prototypes, and scalable component design systems.
- [Graphic & Brand Design](https://infohq.in/services/brand-design): Modern logos and visual identities, complete brand style guidelines, investor pitch decks & presentation decks, and marketing/social asset kits.
- [Social Media Management](https://infohq.in/services/social-media-management): Monthly content calendar planning, custom branded post/carousel design for LinkedIn, X/Twitter, and Instagram, technical copywriting, and analytics.
- [Digital Marketing](https://infohq.in/services/digital-marketing): Search Engine Optimization (SEO), high-intent Google Search and LinkedIn paid ad campaigns, conversion funnel tracking with GA4, and landing page optimization.

## Portfolio & Case Studies
- [Portfolio Overview](https://infohq.in/portfolio): Real-world shipped projects across web applications, mobile platforms, enterprise AI, and workflow automation.
- [SeHAT SmartCare AI](https://infohq.in/portfolio#sehat): Intelligent Android healthcare assistance platform combining medical language models, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), semantic search, report OCR, and multilingual support (English, Hindi, Hinglish).
